title: PHP Conference Japan 2019 CFP Started
content:
PHP Conference Japan 2019

Conference Date : 2019/12/1 in Tokyo/JAPAN

CFP Deadline : 2019/9/2 23:59:59 JST

We will announce you when your proposal is approved by mid ~ late September.

Unfortunately, this CfP system doesn\'t support English UI. 😢 Please use browser translation feature to submit your proposal. Sorry for the inconvenience.Submit your papers!!
author: PHP.net news & announcements
